condition: progressively expanding smooth bald patch on the central crown scalp over 6 months in an adult woman with dark brown skin
level_rationale: A progressively widening smooth hairless patch on the vertex crown over 6 months in a 38-year-old woman with dark brown skin and a 4-year history of tight braided hairstyles suggests central centrifugal cicatricial or scarring alopecia requiring dermatologist evaluation for trichoscopy, scalp biopsy, and follicle-sparing anti-inflammatory therapy, whereas noticing mild dry white flaking on the scalp over 6 months after wearing braids reflects benign dandruff or dry scalp manageable with routine over-the-counter shampoo self-care.

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (38-year-old woman with dark brown skin, 4 years of tight braided hairstyles, and 6-month widening smooth crown bald patch) without naming alopecia, with identical digit multisets across all 6 variants and zero stated negatives.
